answer: Ephemeral Attestation Windows: agents may act only inside randomly scheduled 90-second windows announced one hour ahead via a shared beacon. To join, an agent must be physically present at a local relay—an oasis, summit, or meadow node—and solve a timing challenge bound to that window's nonce. One identity per device per window; missed windows reset standing. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must field 1,000 devices at 1,000 relay locations within each hour, paying hardware, transport, and idle waiting time per window rather than a one-time fee.
